title: Rethinking the Necessity of Adaptive Retrieval-Augmented Generation through the Lens of Adaptive Listwise Ranking
authors: Jun Feng; Jiahui Tang; Zhicheng He; Hang Lv; Hongchao Gu; Hao Wang; Xuezhi Yang; Shuai Fang
why_relevant: Proposes an adaptive listwise reranker with passage dropout that filters noisy retrieved passages and decides when retrieval is unnecessary, directly addressing noise filtering and adaptive retrieval control in RAG.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on efficiency/adaptive ranking rather than adversarial or conflict robustness.
